data.sql: SELECT experience, alignment, commission_id FROM players WHERE player_id = @{admin_player_id};
UPDATE players SET experience = 90, alignment = 1000 WHERE player_id = @{admin_player_id};

INSERT INTO engine_events (ts,type,actor_player_id,sector_id,payload,idem_key) SELECT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,'player.trade.v1',player_id,sector_id,json_build_object('player_id',player_id,'type','player.trade.v1','credits_delta',100,'is_illegal',FALSE,'sector_id',sector_id)::text,'v3-xp-ledger:' || to_char(clock_timestamp(),'YYYYMMDDHH24MISSUS') FROM players WHERE player_id = @{admin_player_id} RETURNING engine_events_id;

tests.name: Verify XP, title threshold, and source ledger

data.sql: SELECT p.experience,p.commission_id,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM player_progress_adjustments a WHERE a.source_key='engine_event:' || @{xp_event_id}::text AND a.player_id=p.player_id AND a.xp_delta=10),(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM engine_offset WHERE key='game_engine' AND last_event_id >= @{xp_event_id}) FROM players p WHERE p.player_id=@{admin_player_id};
UPDATE engine_offset SET last_event_id = @{xp_event_id} - 1, last_event_ts = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE key = 'game_engine';

tests.name: Verify replay does not award XP twice

data.sql: SELECT p.experience,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM player_progress_adjustments a WHERE a.source_key='engine_event:' || @{xp_event_id}::text AND a.player_id=p.player_id) FROM players p WHERE p.player_id=@{admin_player_id};
UPDATE players SET alignment = -2000 WHERE player_id = @{admin_player_id};

tests.name: Insert zero-XP event to refresh alignment title

data.sql: INSERT INTO engine_events (ts,type,actor_player_id,sector_id,payload,idem_key) SELECT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,'player.trade.v1',player_id,sector_id,json_build_object('player_id',player_id,'type','player.trade.v1','credits_delta',0,'is_illegal',FALSE,'sector_id',sector_id)::text,'v3-xp-ledger-title:' || to_char(clock_timestamp(),'YYYYMMDDHH24MISSUS') FROM players WHERE player_id = @{admin_player_id} RETURNING engine_events_id;
